<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Compliance Transactions</subject>
<body>
I spoke with each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this issue was deferred due to other urgent matters. However, everyone agreed that a fixed cutoff time would be suitable for compliance transaction approvals.

The best approach would be to set a daily cutoff at 4pm (to get a sense of volume, I reviewed yesterday’s activity to see how many approvals were submitted after 4pm London time. There were three Corporate unit cases and two Compliance unit cases submitted). After 4pm, any pending approvals would automatically roll over to the following business day. That said, for those approvals not deferred after 4pm, the various advisory teams must remember these count as the next day’s work. I’m unsure how the procedures in the Litigation practice would need to be adjusted for the daily status reports, since the official records wouldn’t reflect these late approvals. Could the Litigation team run supplementary reports to ensure the advisory desks have accurate case statuses each morning?

I would welcome any feedback you have, and please confirm whether a 4pm cutoff works for your respective teams.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric – are there any concerns around the Compliance Procedure Review?  
Mary – we touched on this briefly a few weeks ago... any updates?
</body>
